items.note: The letter is addressed "Dear Ms. Alvarez."
Apartment 4B appears in the subject line, the first sentence and the sign-off.
It says the heater "stopped working on October 2."
It says the writer called on October 3 and "haven't heard back."
It says overnight temperatures are "in the 40s." It leaves out °F, but the meaning is clear in context.
It asks for a repair "within 48 hours of this email," and the subject line repeats this.
It cites Section 12 of the lease as requiring the landlord to provide heat.
The tone is courteous, allowing that the phone message may not have arrived and thanking her. It is also firm, with a clear deadline, a lease citation and a request for a visit time.
The letter says nothing about withholding rent and makes no other threats.
It is about 105 words including the subject line, well under 150.
